dockerfile:
FROM lcr.loongnix.cn/library/php:8.2-apache-sid
COPY site /var/www/html/
ENV TZ=Asia/Shanghai
EXPOSE 80

FROM lcr.loongnix.cn/library/debian:sid-20250615
RUN printf 'Types: deb\nURIs: http://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/debian\nSuites: sid\nComponents: main\nSigned-By: /usr/share/keyrings/debian-archive-keyring.gpg\n' > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/debian.sources && rm -f /etc/apt/sources.list
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends apache2 libapache2-mod-php ca-certificates php8.4-gd php8.4-mysql && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
COPY site /var/www/html/
RUN chown -R www-data:www-data /var/www/html
ENV TZ=Asia/Shanghai
EXPOSE 80
CMD ["sh","-c",". /etc/apache2/envvars && exec apache2 -D FOREGROUND"]

FROM lcr.loongnix.cn/library/php:8.2-apache-sid
COPY rc /var/www/html/
RUN cd /usr/src/php/ext && docker-php-ext-install pdo_mysql intl 2>/dev/null || docker-php-ext-install pdo_mysql
RUN chown -R www-data:www-data /var/www/html/temp /var/www/html/logs 2>/dev/null || true
EXPOSE 80
CMD ["apache2-foreground"]

FROM lcr.loongnix.cn/library/debian:sid-20250615
RUN printf 'Types: deb\nURIs: http://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/debian\nSuites: sid\nComponents: main\nSigned-By: /usr/share/keyrings/debian-archive-keyring.gpg\n' > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/debian.sources && rm -f /etc/apt/sources.list
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends apache2 libapache2-mod-php ca-certificates php8.4-gd php8.4-sqlite3 php8.4-curl php8.4-zip && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

COPY site /var/www/html/

FROM lcr.loongnix.cn/library/debian:sid-20250615
RUN printf 'Types: deb\nURIs: http://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/debian\nSuites: sid\nComponents: main\nSigned-By: /usr/share/keyrings/debian-archive-keyring.gpg\n' > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/debian.sources && rm -f /etc/apt/sources.list
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends apache2 libapache2-mod-php php8.4-gd php8.4-mysql php8.4-sqlite3 php8.4-curl php8.4-xml php8.4-zip php8.4-intl php8.4-mbstring unzip ca-certificates && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
COPY autoconfig.php /var/www/html/config/autoconfig.php
COPY nc.zip /opt/nc.zip
RUN unzip -q /opt/nc.zip -d /var/www/html/ && rm /opt/nc.zip && chown -R www-data:www-data /var/www/html
ENV TZ=Asia/Shanghai
EXPOSE 80
CMD ["sh","-c",". /etc/apache2/envvars && exec apache2 -D FOREGROUND"]
